Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1991
ACT III OF 1991
BANK (NATIONALIZATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 6th April, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 2nd
April, 1991 and hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Banks (Nationalization) (Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4, Act XIX of 1974

ACT III OF 1991
ACT III OF 1991
BANK (NATIONALIZATION) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Banks (Nationalization) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 6th April, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 2nd
April, 1991 and hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 4, Act XIX of 1974.--In the Banks
(Nationalization) Act, 1974 (XIX of 1974), section 4 shall be re-numbered as
subsection (1) of that section and, after subsection (1), re-numbered as
aforesaid, the following new subsections shall be added, namely:--
"(2)
Notwithstanding anything contained in subsection (1), the Federal Government
may, if it is satisfied that it would be in the public interest to do so, by
order in writing, permit the establishment of a bank, subject to such terms and
conditions as may be specified in such Order.
(3) The
provisions of this Act, other than this section, shall not apply to a bank
established in pursuance of permission granted under subsection (2):".
